planets.name: HAT-P-6 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Sterrennacht with a 3.85-day year, found in 2007.

text.card: HAT-P-6 b was found in 2007 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Sterrennacht. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2007, disc_facility HATNet, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 3.85299668, pl_radj 1.48, pl_bmassj 1.32

quotes.title: HAT-P-6b
quotes.card: HAT-P-6b is a transiting extrasolar planet discovered by Noyes et al. on October 15, 2007.
quotes.introduction: It is located approximately 910 light-years away in the constellation of Andromeda, orbiting the star HAT-P-6.
